answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital, forcing an attacker to cross a financial ridge to secure voting power. By requiring agents to solve a unique cipher linked to staked assets, the network ensures that each digital mirror of an entity carries a commensurate economic cost. An adversary attempting to inflate influence must risk substantial collateral, rendering the creation of infinite malicious clones prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
